Tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor, entreprenörer och samhällsaktörer driver du komplexa program som stärker Sveriges framtida elförsörjning. Om tjänsten I rollen som programledare anläggningsprojekt ansvarar du för ett av Svenska kraftnäts investeringsprogram inom anläggningsverksamheten på division Nät. Du leder, styr och organiserar programmet med ansvar för att programmets mål uppnås inom tid, kostnad, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö. Rollen innebär ett stort ansvar och många kontaktytor. Du samarbetar nära interna funktioner, projektorganisationer, entreprenörer, myndigheter, kommuner, regionnätsbolag och andra externa intressenter. Som programledare företräder du Svenska kraftnät som beställare och har en central roll i att skapa förutsättningar för framgångsrika investeringar i transmissionsnätet. I rollen ingår bland annat att: Leda program i storleksordningen 10–30 miljarder kronor bestående av cirka 20–40 anläggningsprojekt. Ansvara för att programmets mål uppnås avseende tid, kostnad, resultat, arbetsmiljö och säkerhet. Skapa förutsättningar för ett effektivt samarbete mellan medarbetare, konsulter, entreprenörer och andra intressenter. Driva och samordna prognoshantering, resursplanering, tidplanering och riskhantering. Föra dialog med externa aktörer såsom myndigheter, kommuner, regionnätsbolag och leverantörer. Företräda Svenska kraftnät som beställare och agera ombud i entreprenadkontrakt. Rapportera till styrgrupp och bidra med underlag inför taktiska och strategiska beslut. Bidra till utvecklingen av arbetssätt, processer och programstyrning inom verksamheten. Organisera, koordinera och utveckla programverksamheten tillsammans med övriga programledare. Som programledare får du möjlighet att arbeta både med strategi och genomförande. Du leder genom andra och samlar människor kring gemensamma mål i en verksamhet där många aktörer behöver samverka för att investeringarna ska kunna genomföras på ett effektivt sätt. Du tillhör en av tre sektioner inom avdelningen Nätinvesteringar. Sektionen samlar Svenska kraftnäts programledare och består idag av 14 programledare och en sektionschef. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att planera, leda och utveckla några av Sveriges största investeringar inom elnätsinfrastruktur. Du blir samtidigt en del av division Nät, som ansvarar för att utveckla, bygga och förvalta Sveriges transmissionsnät. Divisionen har en central roll i den omfattande nätutbyggnad som krävs för att möta samhällets ökande elbehov och möjliggöra energiomställningen. Här får du möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av samhällskritisk infrastruktur och vara med på en av de största investeringssatsningarna i Sverige. Om dig Skallkrav: Personliga egenskaper: Vi söker dig som är resultatorienterad och skapar framdrift i komplexa sammanhang där många aktörer behöver samverka för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar ansvar för helheten, gör väl avvägda prioriteringar och har fokus på att leverera resultat. Du är samarbetsorienterad, bygger förtroendefulla relationer och skapar engagemang hos andra. Som person är du även övertygande och trygg i att företräda verksamheten. Du kommunicerar tydligt och får gehör för de lösningar och prioriteringar som krävs för att nå uppsatta mål. Vidare är du analytisk och kan snabbt sätta dig in i komplexa frågeställningar, värdera information och fatta välgrundade beslut. Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Utbildning: Du har en civilingenjörsexamen inom relevant område eller motsvarande erfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät bedömer som likvärdig. Du har även: Minst tio års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa projekt. Minst tio års dokumenterad chefserfarenhet med personal- och resultatansvar inom entreprenadverksamhet. Tidigare erfarenhet att arbeta som programledare i statlig verksamhet. Erfarenhet av att verka som ombud för större entreprenadkontrakt med kontraktsvärden över en miljard kronor. B-körkort. God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska. Meriterande Erfarenhet av arbete med transmissionsnätsanläggningar. Erfarenhet av att driva och agera som ombud för projekt med partneringkontrakt. Erfarenhet av att utveckla processer för partnering och strategiska partneringkontrakt. Dokumenterad vana av kommersiella förhandlingar kopplade till komplexa entreprenadkontrakt. Bra att veta Tjänsten är placerad i Luleå. Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %. Resor inom Sverige förekommer regelbundet. För tjänsten ingår även resor till Svenska kraftnäts huvudkontor i Sundbyberg. Sista ansökningsdag är den 22 oktober 2026. Vid din ansökan kommer du att besvara ett antal frågor istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev. Vi behöver endast ditt CV. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T. Conduct user research, participate in customer interviews, and run usability tests to gather feedback and inform design decisions. Apply WCAG 2.1 AA standards in every design and component, including keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader support. Review and refine implemented designs to maintain visual consistency, usability, and quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, share design decisions, and incorporate feedback to continuously improve the product. Must Haves 3+ years of experience in product design, design engineering, or a hybrid design and front-end development role. Strong design skills across user flows, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping. Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript, with experience in modern frameworks such as React or Vue. Familiarity with version control and code review. Experience with Figma or similar tools, and experience using and contributing to design systems and component libraries in both design files and code. Foundational UX research skills, including usability testing and incorporating feedback into design decisions. Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and assistive technology testing. A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end process, from research through shipped outcomes, including work built in code. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Managers and Engineers. Nice to Haves Experience in the nonprofit industry. Experience working in a B2B SaaS environment. Why Join Neon One? At Neon One, our values are how we show up every day. We make good happen by putting empathy and passion at the center of our work, using technology to uplift mission-driven organizations. review_candidates.description: Location Memphis, TN Category Postdoc Department Developmental Neurobiology Shift Weekday Day Position Type Full Time Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Req # JR7470 Job Description A postdoctoral research associate position is available with Dr. Bikoff. The Bikoff lab (https://www.stjude.org/research/labs/bikoff-lab.html) in the Department of Developmental Neurobiology at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate interested in studying motor circuitry in mice. Projects will focus on the synaptic and circuit organization of neurons in the spinal cord, and how these circuits ultimately shape motor output. Our laboratory aims to understand the organization and function of neural circuits that control movement, with a particular focus on circuits in the spinal cord that directly control motor output. Projects in the lab can be broadly organized into three thematic areas: dissecting the diversity of cell types in the nervous system, understanding the circuit architecture through which neurons receive and convey information, and defining the functional role of these circuits in motor control. This position will specifically focus on investigating the synaptic and circuit organization of genetically defined populations of spinal interneurons that are critically important for movement. The project will employ a range of approaches including mouse genetics, viral tracing strategies, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and imaging methodologies. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds who would thrive in a highly collaborative, fun, and supportive environment that also provides the freedom to independently develop a research project and take it in new directions. The Bikoff lab is strongly committed to providing individual mentoring and training, as well as ongoing support at all stages of career development. Required Qualifications A PhD or MD/PhD in neuroscience or a related discipline Strong experimental training and the ability to independently design and execute experiments and interpret data Ability to work in a multidisciplinary, highly collaborative environment Excellent oral and written communication skills Strong record of peer-reviewed publications Preferred Experience Prior experience in studying neural circuits, including familiarity with mouse genetics and viral tools Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. R, Python) and an ability to work with large datasets Familiarity with single-cell genomic and/or spatial transcriptomic approaches for molecular profiling St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is a world-class research institution dedicated to pediatric cancer and other catastrophic diseases of childhood. The first and only National Cancer Institute (NCI)-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center devoted solely to children. Our 300 faculty work across the spectrum of basic, translational, clinical, and population science in a highly collaborative multidisciplinary environment that includes a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy of Science and the National Academy of Medicine. St. Jude is ranked on Fortune Magazine's "Best Workplaces in Health Care & Biopharma" and Glassdoor's "Best Places to Work," and is located in the heart of Memphis, Tennessee, a vibrant and friendly city at the historic American crossroads of music, trade, food and culture. We Are In Pursuit Of The Brightest Minds In Biomedical Sciences, Individuals Poised To Contribute To Our Research Progress. Other Than Access To Top-quality Scientists And Mentors, As a Postdoctoral Trainee At St. Jude, You Will Have A Blend of Academic Freedom and Industrial Efficiency: Access to shared resources and facilities led by expert scientists, coupled with cutting-edge technology, accelerates research productivity. Customized Professional and Career Growth: Experience specifically designed programs to enhance professional growth and career readiness empowering postdocs for success beyond their training. This includes access to grant writing workshops, individual development plans, teaching and mentoring opportunities, non-research career advancement programs, professional development allowance, and so much more. Competitive Compensation: Embark on your journey with a competitive salary starting at $72,500 a year, comprehensive benefits and generous relocation assistance, reflecting our commitment to recognize and invest in talent. A Sense of Community: St. Jude fosters a vibrant postdoc community that supports a well-balanced life. A dynamic environment promotes connections and camaraderie among postdocs from all backgrounds. review_candidates.description: Location Memphis, TN Category Postdoc Department Cell and Molecular Biology Shift Weekday Day Position Type Full Time Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Req # JR7632 Job Description The Gibson and Skiniotis research groups invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate to lead a joint effort to uncover fundamental mechanisms of higher-order genome organization. We seek an ambitious postdoctoral scholar that will use cryo-electron microscopy and tomography (cryo-EM/cryo-ET) to analyze chromatin structures within both cells and condensed chromatin assemblies produced in vitro. Candidates will benefit from two world-class training environments and learn modern concepts and techniques in both chromatin biochemistry and biophysics as well as structural analyses using cryogenic electron microscopy. We are seeking a dedicated scientist with a track record of success and a thoughtful and collaborative mindset to drive high-impact projects at the interface of chromatin biology, condensate biophysics, and genome structure. Dual-Mentorship Training Environment This position is co-mentored, with the fellow holding a home in both laboratories and full membership in both groups, including joint lab meetings, shared project planning, and co-authored publications. The Gibson laboratory (Department of Cell & Molecular Biology) studies how phase transitions guide higher-order genome structure and impact human disease, combining chromatin biochemistry, quantitative condensate biophysics, cellular engineering, genomics, and advanced microscopy. The fellow will gain hands-on expertise in nucleosome array reconstitution, chromatin condensate formation and characterization, and the thermodynamic frameworks that connect sequence-level molecular grammar to genome-scale organization. The Skiniotis laboratory (Department of Structural Biology) is internationally recognized for cryo-EM studies of macromolecular signaling complexes, and Dr. Skiniotis serves as founding director of the St. Jude Center of Excellence for Structural Cell Biology (COE-SCB) , which advances multiscale imaging technologies for cells and tissues. The fellow will receive rigorous training in single-particle cryo-EM and in situ cryo-ET, from sample vitrification through high-resolution reconstruction and subtomogram averaging. Very few training environments in the world offer this combination: deep expertise in chromatin and condensate biochemistry alongside frontier structural cell biology, on a single campus, with dedicated institutional support. A fellow who completes this training will emerge with an exceptionally rare and sought-after skill set spanning reconstitution biochemistry, condensate biophysics, and cellular structural biology, positioning them to launch an independent program at the leading edge of genome organization research. The Center of Excellence for Structural Cell Biology (COE-SCB) The COE-SCB Was Established To Move Structural Biology Beyond The Test Tube And Visualize Macromolecular Machines Directly Within Their Native Cellular Context. Working Within The Center And The St. Jude Cryo-Electron Microscopy And Tomography Center, The Fellow Will Have Access To: Multiple high-end transmission electron microscopes, including a 300 keV Titan Krios G4 with cold field emission source (among the world's highest-resolution instruments) and Titan Krios and Talos Arctica platforms equipped with K3 direct electron detectors and BioQuantum energy filters, plus a Talos L120C for rapid screening A complete cryo-ET workflow for in situ structural biology, including cryo-focused ion beam (FIB) milling, correlative cryo-light/electron microscopy, and volume EM approaches under active expansion within the Center Full sample preparation infrastructure (Vitrobot Mark IV, Leica EM GP2, plasma cleaning, glow discharge) Dedicated GPU workstations and clusters with institutional data infrastructure for high-throughput image processing Embedded staff scientists who provide consultation, hands-on training, and mentorship in every step of the workflow, with instrument access and expenses covered institutionally so that science, not cost, sets the pace Position Responsibilities Design and execute experiments to reconstitute and characterize condensed chromatin assemblies in vitro Prepare cryo-EM and cryo-ET specimens of chromatin assemblies and cells, including cryo-FIB milling for in situ tomography Collect, process, and interpret single-particle cryo-EM and cryo-ET/subtomogram averaging datasets Integrate structural findings with biochemical, biophysical, and cellular data to build mechanistic models of genome organization Present research at national and international meetings and prepare high-impact publications Contribute to the collaborative scientific life of both laboratories and mentor junior trainees Minimum Education and/or Training PhD (or MD/PhD) in biochemistry, biophysics, structural biology, cell biology, or a related field, completed or expected at the time of appointment Required: Special Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities A record of research productivity, including first-author publication(s) or preprint(s) Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: cryo-EM/cryo-ET, chromatin or nucleic acid-protein biochemistry, or quantitative biophysics of macromolecular assemblies A passion for rigorous, mechanism-driven science and a thoughtful, collaborative mindset Excellent written and oral communication skills Preferred: Experience with nucleosome or chromatin reconstitution Experience with cryo-EM/cryo-ET data processing (e.g., RELION, cryoSPARC, IMOD, Warp/M) Familiarity with scripting or programming for image analysis (Python, MATLAB, or similar) Compensation and Benefits: Among the Best Available to Postdocs Anywhere St. Jude Offers Postdoctoral Fellows One Of The Strongest Support Packages In Academic Science, And Fellows Are Not Required To Bring Their Own Funding: Competitive salary exceeding the NIH scale, starting at $72,529 and increasing with experience Medical, dental, and vision insurance at $0 premium for individual coverage 401(b) retirement plan with a 7% institutional contribution $2,500 annual professional development allowance for meetings, training, and society memberships Relocation assistance ($8,000 for moves over 100 miles) Individualized career development through the SMaRT (Strategic Milestones and Research Training) Plan, the CAP career advancement fellowship, teaching opportunities at partner institutions, and dedicated career advising On-campus childcare access (Bright Horizons), free state-of-the-art fitness center, generous paid time off, and a provided laptop A vibrant, well-organized postdoc community with social programming, seminars, and institutional fellowships Life in Memphis Memphis offers big-city amenities with a cost of living far below that of most major research hubs, and Tennessee has no state income tax on wages. A postdoc salary goes remarkably far here. The city is home to a world-famous music and food culture, professional sports, beautiful running and biking routes along the Mississippi River, and a warm, welcoming community. The St. Jude campus sits minutes from downtown, and fellows consistently cite quality of life as one of the best parts of training here. About St. Jude St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is a world leader in understanding, treating, and defeating childhood cancer and other life-threatening diseases, pairing academic freedom with exceptional institutional resources in service of a singular mission: Finding cures. review_candidates.description: Kim jesteśmy? Dietly to największy w Polsce marketplace dla cateringów dietetycznych , będący częścią Grupy Żabka . Działamy na styku technologii, logistyki i zdrowego stylu życia – łącząc świat SaaS, e-commerce, logistyki i foodtech w jeden, spójny ekosystem. Jako jeden z nielicznych graczy w Europie rozwijamy model „SaaS-enabled Marketplace” , w którym nasi partnerzy – ponad 300 zakładów produkujących żywność – korzystają z naszego systemu SaaS (MasterLife) do zarządzania produkcją, sprzedażą i obsługą klientów. Dietly to jednak nie tylko oprogramowanie. To również gotowe sklepy e-commerce dla cateringów oraz zintegrowana logistyka D2C, pozwalająca na dostarczenie posiłków w mniej niż 24 godziny od momentu ich przygotowania. Każdego dnia dzięki naszym rozwiązaniom realizowanych jest ponad 100 tysięcy dostaw , a nasz zespół ponad 140 specjalistów pracuje nad tym, by ten złożony ekosystem działał niezawodnie – od pierwszej linijki kodu po zbilansowany posiłek pod Twoimi drzwiami. Na tym stanowisku łączysz działania operacyjne (klikasz i optymalizujesz) z autonomicznym projektowaniem taktyk growth. Twoim celem jest dynamiczne skalowanie wyników sprzedażowych w ekosystemie Web+App dla marketplace’u Dietly oraz portfolio marek cateringów dietetycznych rozwijanych w modelu White Label. Taktyka, egzekucja i optymalizacja Paid Social Zarządzanie kontami: bezpośrednie prowadzenie i ciągła optymalizacja zaawansowanych kampanii w Meta Ads (Advantage+, kampanie konwersyjne, aplikacyjne, wideo) oraz potencjalnie TikTok Ads dla portfolio kilku marek jednocześnie. Efektywność budżetowa: precyzyjne alokowanie budżetów pomiędzy marki i platformy, dobór grup docelowych, optymalizacja strategii biddingowych w oparciu o twarde dane i zwrot z inwestycji (ROAS/POAS/CAC). Ekosystem Web+App: prowadzenie działań dla biznesu dwuplatformowego — optymalizacja kampanii aplikacyjnych, praca z głębokim linkowaniem (OneLinks / Deep Links) oraz narzędziami MMP (np. AppsFlyer), a także rozumienie specyfiki iOS (SKAdNetwork, ATT). Skalowanie kreacji jako lewar wzrostu: systematyczne testowanie hipotez wizualnych, fokus na kreację, która skaluje, iteracja formatów pod specyfikę Meta i TikTok. Proces kreatywny i koordynacja Briefowanie: tworzenie ustrukturyzowanych briefów dla grafików i copywriterów na podstawie wniosków z kampanii i mechaniki poszczególnych platform. Nadzór nad realizacją: dbanie o jakość, dowożenie kreacji na czas i egzekwowanie ich efektywności; iterowanie w cyklu tygodniowym. Analityka, AI i innowacje Wykorzystanie AI: aktywne wdrażanie narzędzi sztucznej inteligencji do automatyzacji pracy, szybkiego copywritingu oraz głębszej analizy danych. Współpraca analityczna: partnerskie współdziałanie ze specjalistami ds. danych przy walidacji zdarzeń e-commerce, konfiguracji w GA4/GTM oraz wdrażaniu rozwiązań typu Server-Side GTM czy Conversions API (CAPI). Szukamy Właśnie Ciebie, Jeśli Posiadasz Doświadczenie: minimum 3–5 lat udokumentowanych sukcesów w samodzielnym prowadzeniu i optymalizacji kampanii Meta Ads z co najmniej sześciocyfrowymi budżetami miesięcznymi (preferowany sektor e-commerce / marketplace / D2C). TikTok Ads: praktyczne doświadczenie w prowadzeniu kampanii lub konkretny plan, jak się w tym rozwinąć w pierwszych miesiącach. Zarządzanie multi-brand: doświadczenie w prowadzeniu działań dla kilku marek lub klientów jednocześnie (środowisko agencyjne lub portfolio marek in-house). Zaplecze analityczne: dobrą znajomość GA4 oraz GTM. Rozumienie idei server-side tracking, analityki aplikacyjnej (MMP, np. AppsFlyer) oraz atrybucji w paid social (Meta Attribution, view-through vs click-through). Sprawność operacyjną: umiejętność precyzyjnego briefowania zespołów kreatywnych i egzekwowania jakości dostarczanych materiałów. Otwartość na technologię: praktyczną znajomość narzędzi AI wspomagających codzienną pracę marketera. Nasz Wspólny Mindset Do Projektów 🎯 Autonomia i pełny ownership: Działamy partnersko i bez mikrozarządzania. Posiadasz swobodę w doborze metod działania, samodzielnie identyfikujesz szanse wzrostu i bierzesz pełną odpowiedzialność za dowożone rezultaty. 💡 Proaktywność i ciekawość technologiczna: Śledzisz rynkowe nowinki, lubisz testować nowe formaty reklamowe, beta-testy Meta i TikTok oraz rozwiązania AI bez czekania na odgórny impuls. 🎨 Kreacja jako motor wyników: Wiesz, że w paid social warstwa wizualna i narracyjna to klucz do sukcesu. Stawiasz konkretne hipotezy kreatywne, weryfikujesz je w testach i bez sentymentu wygaszasz koncepty, które nie generują konwersji. 📊 Pragmatyzm analityczny: Odrzucasz metryki próżności (vanity metrics). Przekładasz dane z analityki na twarde decyzje biznesowe, stale optymalizując wskaźniki ROAS, POAS i CAC. 🗣 Asertywna i przejrzysta komunikacja: Potrafisz budować mosty między światem cyfr (Data/IT), a światem kreacji (Graficy/Copy) oraz jasno przedstawiać wnioski biznesowe. 🗂 Metodyczność i struktura: Dbasz o transparentny porządek w projektach, sprawnie zarządzasz priorytetami w środowisku multi-brand i skutecznie przekształcasz ustalenia w konkretne działania wdrożeniowe. Wynagrodzenie: 10 000 – 13 000 PLN netto + VAT (B2B) Okres wdrożeniowy - zadbamy o Twoje wprowadzenie do naszych systemów i procesów, byś poczuł/a się pewnie w swojej roli. Płatna przerwa w świadczeniu usług oraz elastyczny czas pracy, żeby załatwić swoje sprawy, czy to w urzędzie, czy u dentysty - rozumiemy, że życie potrafi być nieprzewidywalne. :) Elastyczność pod względem miejsca: mamy pet-friendly biuro w Gdańsku Wrzeszcz/ pracę hybrydową/ zdalną Dofinansowanie do karty Multisport i opieki medycznej LUXMED. Zniżki na catering pudełkowy Turbo zespół - przekonaj się sam/-a! Co masz? 🚀 Wpływ na biznes: realny, bezpośredni wpływ na wyniki wiodących marek w rosnącej branży cateringów dietetycznych; portfolio kilku marek, na którym da się rosnąć. 🛠 Autonomię i nowoczesne narzędzia: przestrzeń do testowania nowych rozwiązań technologicznych (AI, advanced tracking) oraz otwartość na Twoje pomysły. Dashboard performance oparty o BigQuery. 👥 Partnerską kulturę: operacyjnie pracujesz od pierwszego dnia z Perfo Managerem — stawiamy na sprawną komunikację (brak zbędnej biurokracji) i partnerskie relacje. 📈 Rozwój: pracę w złożonym ekosystemie (Web+App + kilka marek + White Label) w dynamicznej organizacji — Dietly jest częścią grupy Żabka. ⏱ Elastyczność: pełna swoboda miejsca świadczenia usług, przy zachowaniu terminowości i dbałości o uzgodnione rezultaty. Your work will directly influence project outcomes, team performance, and company growth. This role ensures consistent execution of project controls, reporting, governance, and project management best practices while supporting Project Managers and engineering leadership. The PMO Manager will oversee a team along with the project portfolio performance, drive process standardization, develop reporting and KPI structures, and ensure alignment across project teams, engineering disciplines, and business operations. From project kickoff through IFC issuance, construction support, and record drawings, this role helps ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with EOR requirements and client expectations. Partner with engineering leaders across civil, electrical, structural, and power systems teams to improve project execution and cross-functional coordination. Develop and manage project portfolio dashboards and reporting for executive leadership. Track and analyze KPIs related to project delivery, utilization, backlog, profitability, schedule performance, and client satisfaction. Lead resource planning efforts, ensuring capacity aligns with project demands and business objectives. Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies across the portfolio. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, incorporating lessons learned into PMO processes and standards. Support change management processes, including scope changes, schedule adjustments, and project communication strategies. Facilitate project review meetings, portfolio reviews, and executive reporting sessions. Assist with proposal development, project startup planning, and project management components of client engagements. Support adoption and optimization of project management systems, tools, and reporting platforms. Mentor and develop Project Managers and Project Coordinators, promoting project management best practices throughout the organization. Strong financial and business acumen with the ability to analyze project profitability and operational performance. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience with project management and resource planning software platforms. Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, organizational change, and operational scalability. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting utility-scale solar (50MW+) and battery energy storage projects. Familiarity with engineering design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, and Record Drawings. Experience supporting geographically distributed or remote project teams. Lean, Six Sigma, or project controls certifications are a plus. The ideal candidate is passionate about driving operational excellence, improving project delivery processes, and enabling Project Managers and engineering teams to perform at their highest level. We value leaders who create structure without bureaucracy, promote accountability, and empower teams through clear processes, effective communication, and data-driven decision-making. The PMO Manager plays a critical role in building scalable project management practices, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and supporting the successful delivery of complex utility-scale solar and energy storage projects. Our philosophy: Exceptional project organizations are built by leaders who remove obstacles, provide clarity, continuously improve processes, and create an environment where teams can consistently deliver outstanding results for clients. Professional development and certification support. Collaborative culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and employee growth
